description: This file implements basic tree operations including search, insert, in-order traversal, and free functions for a binary search tree.

methods.name: struct:tree_node * tree_search(struct tree_node * tree,void * key,int (* compare)(const void *,const void *))
methods.description: Performs a binary search in the tree to find a node matching the key using a comparison function.

methods.name: struct:tree_node * tree_insert(struct tree_node ** rootp,void * key,int (* compare)(const void *,const void *))
methods.description: Inserts a new node with the specified key into the binary search tree, maintaining the tree properties.

methods.name: void infix_walk(struct tree_node * t,void (* action)(void * arg,void * key),void * arg)
methods.description: Performs an in-order traversal of the tree, executing an action at each node.

methods.name: void tree_free(struct tree_node * t)
methods.description: Recursively frees the memory allocated for the tree nodes.
